package.description: Inspect and interact with the visual tree of running Windows applications

en-US.description: Inspect and interact with the visual tree of running Windows applications
en-US.longDescription: lvt is a Windows CLI and graphical viewer for inspecting the visual tree of running applications. It detects Win32, ComCtl, Windows XAML, WinUI 3, WPF, WinForms, Avalonia, and Chromium UI; can output visual or UI Automation trees; captures annotated screenshots; and supports UI interaction and MCP-based computer-use workflows.
en-US.name: lvt
